description: Re-including the specified recursively restricted old-language formula recovers exactly the original doubled-language syntax.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.include_stripFormula.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  {α : Type z} {k : ℕ} (A : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).BoundedFormula α k)
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.OldOnly
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubleOld.onBoundedFormula
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.stripFormula A h) =
    A
